lines.en: I drift along; my feet never touch stone.
The lichen cave's draft carries me.
I float around the stalactites, slowly.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖在后面，像一缕烟。
lines.en: My tail trails behind like a wisp of smoke.

lines.zh: 飞到那块苔藓上歇一歇。
lines.en: Fly to that moss and rest a while.

lines.zh: 洞里的光都是我这样的。
lines.en: The light in this cave is all our kind.

lines.zh: 我不急，飘到哪里算哪里。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; wherever I drift is fine.

lines.zh: 前面有滴水声，我去看看。
lines.en: There is dripping ahead; let me look.
I glide just under the cave roof.
I am so light the draft pushes me aside.
I pass a patch of glowing moss.
After drifting long, I fade a little.
I hang in the air, still.
The lichen glows below me.
My outline wavers on the wall.

lines.zh: 洞里安静得能听见苔长。
lines.en: The cave is so quiet I hear moss grow.

lines.zh: 我在看一队蚂蚁搬东西。
lines.en: I am watching ants carry things.
My body brightens and dims like breathing.

lines.zh: 我忘了自己要飞去哪儿。
lines.en: I forgot where I was flying.
A bat passes close by.

lines.zh: 我在数钟乳石滴下的水。
lines.en: I am counting drops from the stalactites.
Hanging like this is pleasant.
Your torch is too bright.
I hover at the edge of your light.
Living folk rarely come down here.
I have circled you three times, watching.
Do not look up; I will scatter.
Your shadow is long on the moss.
You smell of the outside wind.
I followed you for a stretch.
Are you afraid? I do not bite.

lines.zh: 你的火把能借我照一会吗？
lines.en: May I borrow your torch's light a while?
My body scatters and closes again.

lines.zh: 那一剑穿过去，什么也没砍到。
lines.en: The sword passed through and cut nothing.
My light dropped a notch.
You broke my shape apart.
I do not bleed; I leak light.
The cave echoes; my head aches.
I retreat to the moss.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起死那天。
lines.en: That reminds me of the day I died.
You are spending your strength on the wrong thing.
One more cut and I come apart.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，早忘了怎么吃。
lines.en: I do not eat; I forgot how.

lines.zh: 你手里那点食物，收着吧。
lines.en: Keep that bit of food in your hand.
I prefer the glow of moss.
The smell of bread is so strange.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我就过来。
lines.en: Raise your torch and I will come.
I am not hungry; only curious.

lines.zh: 那东西对活人有用，对我没用。
lines.en: That helps the living, not me.
I can no longer smell sweetness.
Eat it; I will watch.
Light draws me more than food.
You passed through me; it was cool.
We collide and I briefly scatter.
Do not wave; I get brushed aside.
My body has no weight.
You shivered, did you not?
Your bump pressed me to the wall.
One touch and my light shudders.

lines.zh: 你脚步太快，风都跟不上。
lines.en: You walk too fast; even the draft lags.
I slip around behind your shoulder.
Do not grab; your hand closes on nothing.

lines.zh: 这种时候，我们只在深处。
lines.en: At such times, we stay deep.

lines.zh: 我的光会变成另一个人认得的颜色。
lines.en: My light turns a color only one other knows.

lines.zh: 我们成对飘，不发出声音。
lines.en: We drift in pairs, making no sound.

lines.zh: 一窝会有一到四只幼虫。
lines.en: A clutch will hold one to four larvae.

lines.zh: 别跟着，这段路不给活人看。
lines.en: Do not follow; this path is not for the living.
The one I seek has the faintest light.

lines.zh: 产下的幼虫自己找地衣。
lines.en: The larvae find lichen on their own.
We keep our distance from you now.
The cave will remember this night.

lines.zh: 等幼虫孵出来，我就不管了。
lines.en: Once they hatch, I am done with them.

lines.zh: 我的手是光做的，拿不住。
lines.en: My hands are made of light; they hold nothing.

lines.zh: 那枚东西穿过了我，落在地上。
lines.en: It passed through me and hit the ground.
Just kick it along.
I can puff it along a little.

lines.zh: 掉下去的东西，我留不住。
lines.en: Things that fall, I cannot keep.

lines.zh: 亮的东西落进苔里，就看不见了。
lines.en: Bright things vanish into the moss.
I tried to grab; my fingers are empty.
Is that something from when I lived?
Take it; I have no need.
I cannot push; only the draft can.
You stepped on that patch of lichen.
Your torch is too close.
You touched our eggs.

lines.zh: 我平时不追人，今天例外。
lines.en: I do not chase people, but today is different.
The moss in this cave is mine.
My light has gone cold.
You bring too much heat.
I will drive you out.
You dug the moss off the wall.
Those larvae have not opened their eyes.
I have settled on you; do not try to leave.
You broke the quiet here.
Go, go up, do not look back.
I know your breathing now.

lines.zh: 你的靴子蹭亮了那块地衣。
lines.en: Your boot scuffed the lichen patch.

lines.zh: 我飘在你头顶，慢慢跟着。
lines.en: I drift above your head, following slowly.

lines.zh: 你点火把，我就知道你在哪。
lines.en: Light a torch and I know where you are.
I slide along the cave wall to get around.
I have dimmed my light.

lines.zh: 你听得见风声吗？那是我。
lines.en: Hear that draft? That is me.
I count how many steps you take.
The more you run, the clearer you are.

lines.zh: 洞口只有一个，你出不去。
lines.en: There is one exit, and you will not reach it.

lines.zh: 我在滴水声里藏着自己。
lines.en: I hide myself in the dripping sound.
You stop, and I stop as well.
The moss glows where I am.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过你的后颈。
lines.en: My tail brushes the back of your neck.
Do not hug the wall; I am on it.
You are too close to the larvae.

lines.zh: 我在蘑菇伞下等你走过。
lines.en: I wait under the mushroom caps for you.

lines.zh: 你的火把越亮，你越显眼。
lines.en: The brighter your torch, the clearer you are.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的头顶飞，不碰。
lines.en: I glide above your head without touching.

lines.zh: 你走错了一个岔口，我在那。
lines.en: You took the wrong fork. I am there.

lines.zh: 我穿过你，你打了个寒战。
lines.en: I pass through you and you shiver.

lines.zh: 我的光烧在你皮肤上，是冷的。
lines.en: My light burns cold on your skin.
I press against your face.
This blow makes no sound.
You are shaking; I can feel it.
I pour cold down your collar.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的火把，吹灭了。
lines.en: I seize your torch and blow it out.
Hold still; move and I come closer.
My hand passes through your armor.
You fall back; I follow you down.
The moss in the cave strikes for me.
This bite has no teeth, only chill.
Frost forms on you.

lines.zh: 我不停，除非你离开洞穴。
lines.en: I will not stop unless you leave the cave.

lines.zh: 我从你胸口穿过去，慢慢穿。
lines.en: I pass through your chest. Slowly.

lines.zh: 我吹熄你的火，连同这口气。
lines.en: I blow out your flame, and your breath with it.
I rise out of the moss.

lines.zh: 这一片地衣今天多了一只。
lines.en: This patch of lichen has one more today.

lines.zh: 我记得自己躺在地衣里。
lines.en: I remember lying in the lichen.

lines.zh: 我还没有形状，先亮一会儿。
lines.en: I have no shape yet; let me glow a while.
The cave draft woke me.
I smell wet moss and stone.

lines.zh: 我生前也走过这样的洞。
lines.en: In life I walked a cave like this.

lines.zh: 上面那层地面，我已经忘了。
lines.en: I have forgotten the surface.

lines.zh: 我的光很小，够照见自己。
lines.en: My light is small, enough to see myself.
A living one came down; how rare.

lines.zh: 我在数这是第几次醒来。
lines.en: I am counting how many times I have woken.

lines.zh: 苔藓把我托着，像一张床。
lines.en: The moss holds me like a bed.
Let me drift a lap and learn the paths.
Do not fear; I just woke and chase no one.

lines.zh: 火把靠近，我的边缘卷起来。
lines.en: The torch nears and my edges curl.
I float, but the stone came down on me.

lines.zh: 水对我不算什么，只是变重。
lines.en: Water means little; I just get heavier.
The blast scatters me into mist.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，钉进后面的苔。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and sticks in the moss.

lines.zh: 魔法的光和我很像，也伤我。
lines.en: Magic glows like me, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我会变淡。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet I fade.

lines.zh: 雷声在洞里滚，我的光碎了。
lines.en: Thunder rolls in the cave and my light shatters.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有苔，我会散掉。
lines.en: In the void there is no moss; I will come apart.
